text: This is a two-year full-time Master program taught in English. The prestigious faculty, internationally taught courses and innovative lab-based teaching method are to cultivate financial professionals who are not only versed in modern financial theory, sophisticated quantitative tools and practical knowledge of the financial industry but also competent in the role of management in a financial institute. Who should apply? Candidates for SAIF’s Master in Finance program must have a strong analytical background. The course-work introduces to students the necessary skill sets of a financial professional. Upon the completion of the program, the students will have a good understanding of the theories and quantitative methods of modern finance, and how they are applied to real business situations. Features The course will offer you: High-calibre curriculum at the same level as other top finance programs; Courses taught by world-class scholars and leading financial professionals; Admission open to all English speakers; Emphasis on quantitative methodology; A balanced structure comprising both theory and application; Innovative teaching e.g. lab-based practical sessions. Specializations Investment Management; Corporate Finance; Risk Management and Financial Engineering. Duration The progra m is two years in total. Upon completion of all coursework and the thesis, students will be conferred by Shanghai Jiao Tong University a Master degree certificate and a graduation diploma. Those students who finish the program requirements in less than two years are eligible for consideration of early graduation. Fees The tuition for an international student of 2012’s entering class is US$20,000 (approximately RMB 128,000), payable in two installments. Each payment has to be made at the beginning of each academic year. The tuition includes the user fees for all SJTU's facilities during the entire two-year program. However, it does not cover living costs. Medical insurance is available at additional cost.
